# generated by scripts/changelog.ts from the CHANGELOG.md files of the packages
version: 0.9.0
date: 2026-10-26

### Added

- Add the smaller copies and the focus point of a library picture to `::figure`, and a 4:3 `landscape` aspect ratio ([#61](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/61))

### Changed

- Change the Markdown parser to comark 0.8: heading anchors stay the same, and a code block without a code component now has `data-language` instead of `language`. ([#59](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/59))
- Change component definitions to refuse prop names that end in `Html`, which a component would write as markup. ([#59](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/59))
- Change the docs side navigation to read its tabs and sections through Ginko's shared navigation rules, which the Studio's new navigation tree uses too; the navigation it shows stays the same. ([#63](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/63))
- Change docs pages (`docsCollection`) and the free pages of the starter templates to use drafts: on the platform, Speichern on a live page keeps the change unpublished until Veröffentlichen; pass `drafts: false` to `docsCollection` to keep one-step saving. ([#64](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/64))
- Change new sites to start with Nuxt 4.6.2, Vue 3.5.44, nuxt-og-image 7.0.7 and vue-tsc 3.3.13. ([#59](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/59))

### Fixed

- Fix an enlarged `::figure` to show the whole picture instead of its crop ([#61](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/61))
